quarterly_data.quarter: Fujifilm press release: Fujifilm Installs Manufacturing Equipment for Antibody-Drug (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Bio CDMO capacity: Fujifilm will install manufacturing equipment for antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) linker-payloads at the Hirono Plant (Fukushima Prefecture), operated by a manufacturing subsidiary of FUJIFILM Wako Pure Chemical, scheduled to become operational in 2028 (reaction vessels, filtration and drying equipment, a preparative HPLC system and new process / analytical development laboratories, with containment upgraded for highly potent substances below an OEL of 0.1 ug/m3). With the FUJIFILM Toyama Chemical facility, scheduled to begin operations in 2027 for antibody manufacturing, conjugation and drug-product manufacturing, the group will offer what it calls Japan's first one-stop ADC CDMO service. No investment amount is stated.
quarterly_data.figure: Hirono linker-payload equipment operational in 2028; FUJIFILM Toyama Chemical ADC facility to begin operations in 2027
